newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE nearby white sugar closes with minor losses.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE nearby white sugar closes with minor losses.

text.p: Nearby London white sugar closed barely weaker on Tuesday evening after holding in a narrow range.
August ended 10 cents easier at $323.50 per tonne after trading between $321.50 and $323.60.
Some of the further forward months finished with modest gains, such as March 1998, which closed 70 cents firmer at $315.00.
Turnover totalled 1,541 lots, with 761 lots in August, 401 lots in October and 223 lots in March.
In Paris, August finished 20 cents firmer at $322.70 and March 1998, the only other contract that traded, ended 50 cents higher at $314.50.
